items.title_en: Anthropic Researcher Quits Over 'Dangerous' AI Race, Warns 'AI Could Kill Us All By End Of Decade'
items.title_zh: 人类研究人员退出“危险”的人工智能竞赛，警告“人工智能可能会在十年内杀死我们所有人”
items.summary_en: An Anthropic researcher has resigned over AI safety concerns, warning that labs are racing toward self-improving superintelligence, sparking a heated online debate
items.summary_zh: 一位人类研究人员因人工智能安全问题而辞职，他警告说实验室正在竞相开发自我改进的超级智能，引发了网上的激烈争论
